chapters.label: The break, live
chapters.text: Super Cup final, January 2025. Real Madrid lose the ball at a short corner, and Barcelona break! Yamal and Raphinha race away, and flying up the left comes Alejandro Balde! Raphinha picks him out… goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Balde stays wide and does not rush ahead. Then he sprints, and arrives just as Raphinha is ready to pass.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Balde finishes past Thibaut Courtois! Barcelona win the final five to two.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: time your run, so you arrive just as your teammate is ready to pass!
